_about: Record semantics for a completed Ranger-to-Ranger transfer, under #68's trade protocol (escrow-by-reference, atomic swap, gift as one-way escrow). The transfer mutates exactly ONE seat — current keeper — and appends ONE history entry. Everything else on the #80 record is invariant. Locks are #68's, evaluated before any interface: story_locked can never be escrowed; egg/unhatched excluded; species_untradeable values OPEN.

history_entry_shape.from: outgoing keeper ref — appended to previous_keepers[]

invariant_under_trade: deviations[] (RULED deviations travel with the individual; the record is not edited)
honours (#104 stamps stay on the record)
care history (#28 careLog entries are the individual's past)

mutated.current_keeper: the single seat the trade rewrites
mutated.location_on_commit: set by the RECEIVER's placement (party | garden | storage, #106 kinds — no fourth kind); during escrow the record is escrow-locked at its pre-trade location (no moves, no release); on abort, escrow lifts and nothing has changed

open_register: whether in-world Ranger-to-Ranger trading exists as a game feature
keeper-history seat: on #80's record or in #96's history section (landing decision — one home)
show_lane_note: #68's 'the show lane never trades' governs the SYSTEM. A depicted transfer of care, if a story ever has one, is an authored story event consistent with these semantics. If the owner reads #68 as barring even depiction, that reading wins and the mirror is void — clarification registered in STAGING.
